metadata.title: A scoping review of the relationship between students’ ICT and performance in mathematics and science in the PISA data

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values handling is not applicable because this work is a scoping review that does not conduct an original empirical analysis of PISA achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study synthesizes secondary quantitative studies using PISA data rather than analyzing original student-level datasets, so there is no application of sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it is a scoping review of existing literature.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The excerpts do not mention any validation strategies beyond the synthesis of secondary studies, leaving validation information unclear.
